body:
I started experimenting with drugs at an early age. I've smoked pot on many, many occasions, done coke, acid, meth, shrooms, alcohol, nicotine, xanax, vicodin, percocet, valiums, speed,oxycotin, but nothing has compared to my love of painkillers.
I've done vicodins countless amounts of times, percocets once, but they didn't compare to oxycotin. Oxycotin is a body high that lasts for hours of pleasure. My first use I thought it not to work, an hour went by with nothing but a slight buzz. Then it started to hit me. Like any drug that is time released there is a point where I peak, and believe me it is intense. I get irritated easily with other painkillers and end up pissed off, but not with oxycotin, I am in a good mood the whole time. My experience lasted for at least 5 hours.
Oxycotin is my number 1 for a strong lasting experience.
